polityNote: Russian Empire (Steppe and Turkestan general-governorates) to 1917-11-06. Bukhara and Khiva were protectorates, not provinces, and are outside. Old Style dates converted to Gregorian (+12 days in the 19th century).

sources.title: Акмолинская область (1868—1920) — Википедия (oldid 154849250)
sources.says: Akmola oblast formed by ukaz 21 Oct 1868 No. 46380; opened 1 Jan 1869 with Omsk, Petropavlovsk, Kokchetav, Akmolinsk okrugs; Omsk was temporarily in Tobolsk gub.; later only Sarysu/Atbasar okrug added inside, okrugs renamed uyezds 1898.

sources.title: Область Сибирских Киргизов — Википедия (oldid 152144516)
sources.says: Oblast of Siberian Kirghiz abolished by ukaz 21 Oct 1868 No. 46380; divided into Akmola and Semipalatinsk oblasts; Omsk temporarily in Tobolsk gub. until Akmola oblast opened 1 Jan 1869.

spans.dateNote: Ukaz 21 Oct 1868 O.S. (ПСЗ-2 № 46380) created the oblast; it opened 1 Jan 1869 O.S. = 1869-01-13, when the city of Omsk (temporarily attached to Tobolsk gub.) passed to it. Okrug→uyezd renaming 1898 and the Sarysu/Atbasar okrug 1869 are internal. No outer change found to 1917.

sources.title: Тургайская область (Российская империя) — Википедия (oldid 153692164)
sources.says: Turgay oblast established by ukaz 21 Oct 1868 from the eastern part of the Orenburg Kirghiz oblast; four uyezds (Ilets/Aktyubinsk, Irgiz, Nikolaevsk/Kustanai, Turgay); no territorial change before 1919.

sources.title: Кустанайский уезд — Википедия (oldid 154939706)
sources.says: Nikolaevsk uyezd formed 1868 in Turgay oblast (Ilets, Irgiz, Nikolaevsk, Turgay uyezds); renamed Kustanai 8 (20) Feb 1895; moved to Chelyabinsk gub. only in 1919.

spans.dateNote: Ukaz 21 Oct 1868 O.S. (ПСЗ-2 № 46380) = 1868-11-02; oblast administration opened at Orenburg 2 Jan 1869 O.S. Ilets→Aktyubinsk (1891) and Nikolaevsk→Kustanai (1895) are renamings. No outer change found to 1917.

sources.title: Семипалатинская область (Российская империя) — Википедия (oldid 151483637)
sources.says: Formed 1854; okrugs became uyezds 1868; Zaisan pristavstvo (lands gained by the Chuguchak protocol) attached 1869, Zaisan uyezd 1875; five uyezds in the early 20th century.

sources.title: 伊犁條約 — 維基百科 (oldid 93858717)
sources.says: Sub-protocols: Ili 1882-08-06, Kashgar NE 1882-12-07, Kobdo–Tarbagatai 1883-08-12, Tarbagatai SW 1883-10-03, Kashgar NW (Uzbel) 1884-06-03.

sources.title: Treaty of Saint Petersburg (1881) — Wikipedia (oldid 1375169804)
sources.says: Treaty 24 Feb 1881: Art. 7 new Ili border, Art. 8 adjustments east of Lake Zaysan; Russia evacuated Ili March 1883; final protocol signed 31 Oct 1883.

spans.dateNote: Outer line fixed with the last Russo-Chinese demarcation protocol touching the oblast: Tarbagatai SW protocol 1883-10-03 (Gregorian; = 21 Sep 1883 O.S.), after the Kobdo–Tarbagatai protocol 1883-08-12 that executed Art. 8 (east of Lake Zaisan) of the 1881 treaty. No later outer change found to 1917. / the final Tarbagatai protocol is dated 1883-10-03 (zh.wikipedia) and 1883-10-31 (en.wikipedia); the later date is used and the window between them is unresolved

sources.title: Семиреченская область — Википедия (oldid 152839554)
sources.says: Semirechye oblast established 11 (23) Jul 1867; to Steppe GG 1882/1891, back to Turkestan GG 1 Jul 1899; six uyezds in the early 20th century.

sources.title: Джаркентский уезд — Википедия (oldid 148077157)
sources.says: Dzharkent uyezd of Semirechye oblast formed in 1882 (on the part of the Ili region retained by Russia).

sources.title: 伊犁條約 — 維基百科 (oldid 93858717)
sources.says: Sub-protocols: Ili 1882-08-06, Kashgar NE 1882-12-07, Kobdo–Tarbagatai 1883-08-12, Tarbagatai SW 1883-10-03, Kashgar NW (Uzbel) 1884-06-03.

spans.dateNote: Dzharkent uyezd (1882) took the strip of Ili retained by Russia; Ili protocol 1882-08-06, Kashgar protocol 1882-12-07 and Tarbagatai SW protocol 1883-10-03 (Gregorian) fixed the Chinese line of the oblast. Transfers between Steppe and Turkestan GGs (1882, 1899) did not move the line. / the final Tarbagatai protocol is dated 1883-10-03 (zh.wikipedia) and 1883-10-31 (en.wikipedia); the later date is used and the window between them is unresolved

sources.title: Сырдарьинская область (Российская империя) — Википедия (oldid 153438472)
sources.says: Founded 11 (23) Jul 1867; in 1886 Jizzakh and Khojent uyezds were transferred to the new Samarkand oblast; Amu-Darya otdel later part of the oblast; separated only in 1920.

sources.title: Амударьинский отдел — Википедия (oldid 146367837)
sources.says: Amu-Darya otdel formed 1873 on lands ceded by the Khiva khanate; included in Syr-Darya oblast in 1887.

spans.dateNote: Положение об управлении Туркестанского края, 12 Jun 1886 O.S. (ПСЗ-3 т. VI № 3814), in force 1 Jan 1887 O.S. = 1887-01-13: Jizzakh and Khojent uyezds went to Samarkand oblast and the Amu-Darya otdel became part of Syr-Darya oblast. No outer change found to 1917.

sources.title: Самаркандская область (Российская империя) — Википедия (oldid 152715005)
sources.says: Samarkand oblast formed 1 (13) Jan 1887 from the Zeravshan okrug (1868) with Jizzakh, Katta-Kurgan, Samarkand and Khojent uyezds; existed to 1919.

sources.title: Джизакский уезд — Википедия (oldid 147653056)
sources.says: Jizzakh uyezd formed 1868 in Syr-Darya oblast; transferred to Samarkand oblast in 1886 (effective with its formation).

spans.dateNote: Formed under the 1886 Turkestan statute, in force 1 Jan 1887 O.S. = 1887-01-13 (Wikipedia also cites War Department order 1886 No. 1741). No outer change found to 1917.

sources.title: Ферганская область (Российская империя) — Википедия (oldid 154659986)
sources.says: Fergana oblast founded 5 Mar 1876 from the Kokand khanate; Eastern Pamir (two volosts, Pamir detachment) finally included in the oblast in 1897.

sources.title: ЭСБЕ, «Ферганская область» (т. XXXV, 1902) — Викитека (oldid 5368843)
sources.says: Oblast lies with the Pamir between 37° and 42° N; divided into 5 uyezds and the Pamir; formed 19 Feb 1876 from the Kokand khanate.

spans.dateNote: The RISTAT Osh atom contains the Eastern Pamir. The Pamir was settled by the Anglo-Russian agreement of 1895 and finally included in the oblast in 1897 (day not found); the span starts at the census day 28 Jan 1897 O.S. = 1897-02-09, when the census counted the Pamir inside Fergana oblast. No outer change found to 1917.

sources.title: ЭСБЕ, «Закаспийская область» (т. XII, 1894) — Викитека (oldid 5369307)
sources.says: Merv 1884, Panjdeh 1885, Atek 1886 added; Afghan border delimited 1887; late 1893 Persia ceded Firuza and received Khisar.

sources.title: Закаспийская область — Википедия (oldid 150886779)
sources.says: Formed 6 (18) May 1881 from Akhal-Teke, Krasnovodsk, Mangyshlak units; territory finally formed by 1890; to Turkestan GG 26 Dec 1897; internal pristavstvo transfers only to 1917.

spans.dateNote: Last outer change: Firuza ceded by Persia, Khisar to Persia, late 1893 (ESBE; day not found). Year precision 1894 = first date the source guarantees the 1897 line. Transfer to Turkestan GG (26 Dec 1897 O.S.) did not move the line. Pristavstvo transfers (1891, 1917) are internal.
